GOVERNMENT OF SINDH
SERVICES, GENERAL ADMINISTRATION & COORDINATION DEPARTMENT
(REGULATIONS WING)

NO.RW/1-23/2025: Karachi, dated 14th November, 2025

To,
The Secretary,
Sindh Public Service Commission,
Hyderabad.

SUBJECT: AGE RELAXATION IN UPPER AGE LIMIT FOR THE CANDIDATES OF COMBINED COMPETITIVE EXAMINATION

1. I am directed to refer to the subject noted above and to state that the Government of Sindh has been receiving representations from various candidates seeking relaxation in the upper age limit prescribed for the Combined Competitive Examination, on the ground that the examination could not be held during the preceding years and that the delay was not attributable to the candidates concerned.

2. The matter has been examined in this Department in consultation with the relevant record. Under Rule-6(c) of the XYZ Regulations-2023, the competent authority may, for reasons to be recorded in writing, relax the upper age limit prescribed for admission to the examination in favour of a class or category of candidates whose case is found to be one of undue hardship.

3. The Law Department, on a reference made to it, has furnished the opinion that the proposed relaxation is permissible, provided that the conditions laid down in Rule-23 of the ABC Rules 2020 governing relaxation of rules generally are satisfied, and that the relaxation is extended uniformly to all similarly placed candidates.

4. The estimated number of affected candidates, as reported by the Commission, is approximately twelve thousand, and the proposed relaxation would cover the examinations to be held during the calendar year 2026.

5. It is therefore proposed that the competent authority may be pleased to accord approval to the grant of relaxation of two years in the upper age limit, as a one-time dispensation, in the light of the legal position stated above.

6. This issues with the approval of the Chief Secretary, Government of Sindh.

(MUHAMMAD AHMED)
SECTION OFFICER (R-I)

C.C:
1. The Principal Secretary to the Chief Minister, Sindh.
2. The Secretary, Law Department, Government of Sindh.
3. The Master File.
